description: This bar chart illustrates the average JGA score for two models, LLaMA-7B (represented by orange bars) and T5-small (represented by yellow bars), across 27 turns, labeled as Turn ID from 0 to 26 along the horizontal axis. The vertical axis, labeled “Avg. JGA Score,” is scaled linearly from 0.2 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The chart displays a pair of bars for each Turn ID, with the orange bar for LLaMA-7B consistently appearing taller than the yellow bar for T5-small across all turns. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in ascending order of Turn ID from left to right. At Turn 0, the scores are approximately 0.96 for LLaMA-7B and 0.95 for T5-small. The scores for both models generally decrease over time, with LLaMA-7B maintaining higher scores throughout. At Turn 26, the scores are approximately 0.45 for LLaMA-7B and 0.33 for T5-small. The legend in the upper right corner clearly distinguishes the two models by color.
